The owner taps planets to choose them, drags planets along their orbits, drags the timeline dial, double-taps empty space and orbits with two fingers; the campaign does not synthesise touches on hardware.
rows.pass: Touch-to-frame latency recorded for 200 samples per device; a tap (travel under 10 points, lifted within 0.5 s) on a planet chooses it; a drag of a movable planet (16 points or more) along its orbit shows the ghost preview at the nearest phase and sends exactly one orbit.phase on release; a drag on the timeline dial shows the nearest projected tick under the finger; a drag on a fixed planet explains why nothing moves; a double tap on empty space (within 0.35 s and 22 points) restores the authored orbit.
rows.procedure: Tap planets to choose them, drag a planet along its orbit to preview and set its phase, drag the timeline dial to show a tick, orbit the camera with two fingers and double-tap empty space on each device; the campaign records the interval from touch to the first frame showing the change.
rows.title: Touch feel and touch-to-frame latency

rows.procedure: Turn the Sound toggle on and play a level to a win and to a failure with the haptics switch on, including one refused action (setting a planet to the phase it already has, which the rules refuse); choose planets to hear their auditions; observe the sky's ambient sound and the selection, success, warning and error haptics.
